name: Replicate
billing: Review Replicate billing before running a model. The optional one-image verification example uses FLUX Schnell, approximately US$0.003 per output at the documented rate; actual charges and availability can change.
steps: Create a Replicate account or sign in, then review the account’s billing and payment settings.
Open API tokens. Create a separate, descriptively named token for your application rather than sharing one across environments.
Store the token only in your local environment. Choose the single-image example only after checking the model’s current price.
